title: an outside proof asks build_inspector's judges through codemother's inspect_wire
intention: A proof outside CodeMother asks any build_inspector judge it needs through inspect_wire's ask(), over a scratch bus of its own, and names its roots as arguments instead of writing the inspector's globals.
why: 149b9a1ab9c4 moves 66 outside proofs off importing build_inspector (RULE 1). Measured: they cannot, because nothing published lets them hold CodeMother on a bus, 13 judges they call are not answered, and 7 drive the inspector by writing its globals, which cannot cross a bus.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 7 (a refusal raises, never reads green); outline 9.4.3.3.4 (Q#88)
how: D1: ORDER. Builds on 266d39d56d06 (the inspect verb and inspect_wire), before 149b9a1ab9c4, whose proofs call ask(). Independent of 17d570c10390. D2: ask(judge, *args, **kwargs) in inspect_wire. The first call in a process enters scratch_bus (the cairn device's published tool), holds bus_shim and CodeMotherShim on one DeviceRoster, and keeps them for the process (one bus per proof module, closed at exit). Each call wire_encodes, requests codemother `inspect`, and returns wire_decode(data). accepted False raises: a judge that raised raises again carrying its type name and words; any other refusal raises naming the judge and the reason. The shim import stays inside codemother. D3: INSPECT_JUDGES grows claim_provenance, proofs_exist, constraint_enforcement_holds, crossing_fingerprints_verified, the_nest, declared_runners, _workflow_cursor, proof_covers_the_ticket, buildme_rides_the_rehearsal, build_started, _source_fingerprint, sieve_names, run_sieve, proven_space. SIEVES and _PROVEN_SPACE are not callables, so the inspector gains sieve_names() (sorted SIEVES keys), run_sieve(name, *args, **kwargs) and proven_space() (sorted list) and those are what is listed. D4: FIXTURE, NOT JUDGE KWARGS (revised in build 2026-11-13, CC mechanism). inspect_wire.fixture(berths=, tickets_root=, crossing_roots=) is a context manager that sets the inspector's _CHART_BERTHS, _TICKETS_ROOT and _crossing_roots for one block, on codemother's side of the bus, and restores them on exit. Judge kwargs were the cast plan; they were dropped because _crossing_roots is deliberately a read, not a parameter (inspector.py, precedent clearance._crossing_roots, ticket d2ecdb867bc9): a caller may not choose the evidence the gate reads, but a proof may stand a fixture world behind it. The scratch bus is in-process, so the block's globals are the ones the asked judge reads. No judge signature changes. D5: PROOF, one tooth per falsifier clause, over a scratch bus (NOTRUN with no Postgres, 9.4.8.1).
